label: Sample agreement — Acme Edge API availability pact
role: Provider (wallet A) signs this; Customer (wallet B) accepts it

form_fields.evidence_policy: Use only evidence from the frozen origins below. A status notice alone does not establish an exception; evidence must match the named service and the completed observation window. Unavailable or inconclusive evidence never excuses a miss.

exception_clauses.title: Upstream infrastructure failure
exception_clauses.rule: A documented failure of a named hosting dependency materially caused the service impact during the frozen window.
exception_clauses.proof: Official incident records from the dependency describing start and end times overlapping the observation.

call_arguments.note: What the contract receives when the form above is sealed. target is basis points; amounts are atto-GEN integers; times are Unix seconds.
